carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, hero CTA button fill, logo mark — the dominant non-white color carrying 1000+ borders and all body copy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary surface fill, dark card backgrounds, button borders — one step lighter than Carbon for layered elements

iron.$description: Iron — Body text, input borders, button borders, card borders — the working neutral for readable secondary copy

steel.$description: Steel — Muted headings, subhead text, supporting borders

slate.$description: Slate — Subtle heading text, dividers, light borders

fog.$description: Fog — Image borders, icon borders, tertiary text

silver.$description: Silver — Link borders, decorative dividers, lightest structural lines

mist.$description: Mist — Soft surface fills, secondary button backgrounds, subtle wash backgrounds

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surface, button text on dark fills

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Feature card surfaces, soft highlight panels — the only tinted neutral, used to frame product previews and walkthrough banners

cobalt-spark.$description: Cobalt Spark — Wayfinding dots beside section eyebrows, icon accents, link color — the navigation accent, never used as a fill

lime-glow.$description: Lime Glow — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

apk-galeria.$description: Primary display and body typeface. Carries headlines, body copy, buttons, and quotes with a serif-influenced rhythm. Custom font with no direct open substitute; the signature is its slightly elongated proportions and progressively tighter negative tracking as size scales up (-0.030em at 64px down to -0.009em at 18px). The two-tone headline pattern (one phrase in #0f0f0f, the next phrase in #898989 or #4c4c4c) creates a call-and-response rhythm that defines the brand voice.

apkpraktikal.$description: Categorical label typeface. Used exclusively for section eyebrows (OUR PLATFORM, FEATURED SOLUTIONS), navigation items, tab labels, and badge text. The wide tracking (0.12–0.14em at 14–16px) transforms short labels into uppercase spatial signatures that read more like architectural annotations than headlines. Weight 700 for emphasized CTAs in small caps form.

karla.$description: Karla — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
